item.title: Walking for Beginners: How Fast to Walk Using the Talk Test
item.description: Walking for beginners is easier when you know your pace. Use the talk test: you can talk but not sing. This guide explains it, then gives a 4 week walking workout plan with rest days and what to do when you miss one. Guide contains affiliate links.
